name: foundry-gamesystem-ashford
description: Ashford Adventures game system for Foundry VTT

scripts.pack:npcs: fvtt package pack -n codex-npcs -t Actor --in packs/_source/npcs --out packs -v
scripts.pack:buildings: fvtt package pack -n codex-buildings -t JournalEntry --in packs/_source/buildings --out packs -v
scripts.pack:missions: fvtt package pack -n codex-missions -t JournalEntry --in packs/_source/missions --out packs -v
scripts.pack:talents: fvtt package pack -n talents -t Item --in packs/_source/talents --out packs -v
scripts.pack:traits: fvtt package pack -n traits -t Item --in packs/_source/traits --out packs -v
scripts.pack:creatures: fvtt package pack -n creatures -t Actor --in packs/_source/creatures --out packs -v
scripts.build:packs: npm run generate:packs && npm run pack:npcs && npm run pack:buildings && npm run pack:missions && npm run pack:talents && npm run pack:traits
scripts.unpack:npcs: fvtt package unpack -n codex-npcs -t Actor --in packs --out packs/_source/npcs -c -v
scripts.unpack:buildings: fvtt package unpack -n codex-buildings -t JournalEntry --in packs --out packs/_source/buildings -c -v
scripts.unpack:missions: fvtt package unpack -n codex-missions -t JournalEntry --in packs --out packs/_source/missions -c -v
scripts.unpack:talents: fvtt package unpack -n talents -t Item --in packs --out packs/_source/talents -c -v
scripts.unpack:traits: fvtt package unpack -n traits -t Item --in packs --out packs/_source/traits -c -v
